name: summer-guide
title: Diocese of Wilmington: Summer Vacation Mass Guide
command: pnpm diocese roster import wilmington summer-guide scratch/wilmington-map-1/001-survey/summer-guide.json
notes: Parsed 2026-10-27 from cdow.org's Summer Vacation Mass Guide ('Mass time information is up to date as of May 12, 2026'; page modified 2026-05-11) by scratch/wilmington-map-1/tools/summer_guide.py. Covers only the coastal and Eastern Shore churches (Sussex and Kent DE; the nine Eastern Shore MD counties): 32 churches plus two summer-only Mass sites of St. Edmond, Rehoboth Beach (Parish Hall; Rehoboth Elementary School), listed as entries of their own. group is the parent parish where the heading says 'mission of ...', else the church itself; mass_times keeps the summer weekend lines verbatim (seasonal ranges for St. Andrew, St. Mary Star of the Sea OC, Holy Savior, Church Creek, Rehoboth). States St. Peter, Queenstown was 'Reopening July 4, 2026 following renovation'. Omits Holy Name of Jesus, Pocomoke City and St. Elizabeth, Westover, Marydel, Holy Cross Dover, Seaford, Cecil County's Good Shepherd group and the Warwick shrine.
